name: E. A. Williams
bio: E. A. Williams of Bismarck was nominated for the territorial House at the October 1884 convention and visited Medora in June 1885 with Neil Gilmour of the Bismarck land office. In 1886 he campaigned through Medora as a Republican candidate for the House and was elected that November.
